watch.summary: A streamer repeatedly misses mail delivery targets while driving in a delivery game, leading to sudden fail screens and disbelief.

beats.what: Streamer is driving a mail truck towards the finish line.
He drives right past a package drop-off target.
He reaches the finish line and a big 'DELIVERY FAILED!' screen pops up.
Streamer reacts in disbelief, asking how he missed it.
Jump cut to a new attempt where he misses another package drop on a sharp curve.

watch.author: creator
watch.why: The clip relies on the simple comedic contrast between driving smoothly and completely missing the game's core objective. His genuine perplexity at failing the level gives it a mild, relatable payoff.
